$comment: Coordinator operations (POST /api/ops/<name>), called by the app and, as MCP tools, by agents. operations lists every registered operation: read (a read snapshot), long (no surrounding transaction), errors (status codes the handler itself returns; every operation can also return 401 signed out, 403 role or grant, and 500). Each operation <name> has $defs <Name>Request and <Name>Reply. A failed call answers OpError. planned lists operations specified contract first and not built yet (docs/designs/fleet-definition-editors.md); building one moves it to operations. go/coordinator checks at test time that operations equals its registry.

AccountConnectRequest.$comment: Inspects one native login. hostId: default the caller's host; binding: the native login name.

AccountCreateReply.$comment: A managed-account record: id, name, harness, holder, kind, plan, intake, take, switchPct, comment, bindings and times.

AccountCreateRequest.$comment: harness codex, claude, antigravity or acp; holder: the owner may create one for another person.

AccountDiscoverRequest.$comment: Reads the host's native account catalogue. hostId: default the caller's host.

items.$comment: A host that can run the harness.

AccountHostsRequest.$comment: harness default codex; accountId takes the account's harness.

AccountInspection.$comment: A read-only native inspection queued on a host; an identical one still pending is answered instead of a new one.

items.$comment: A managed-account record with its inspections, checks and setting history.

AccountLoginHandoffReply.$comment: What a person runs to log the binding in; Fleet changes no authentication itself.

AccountUpdateReply.$comment: A managed-account record: id, name, harness, holder, kind, plan, intake, take, switchPct, comment, bindings and times.

AccountUpdateRequest.$comment: Holder or owner; switchPct null clears it; take {projects}; holder: owner only.

Actor.$comment: person: the person (kind person); executionId: the agent execution (kind agent); system: reconcile. directedBy is set for person and agent.

AgentDefinition.$comment: The agent profile (contracts/profile.schema.json); go/contract.ParseProfile is its validator.

AgentListFacts.$comment: harness defaults as at session start; roles: the project roles (project.json roles) that name this profile.

AgentTestRequest.$comment: draft true uses the caller's draft; false the head revision.

ArtifactListReply.$comment: nextBefore: only with limit; null on the last page.

ArtifactRuleConfirmRequest.$comment: Operator only. ruleHash: the preview's hash; a changed rule is 409.

ArtifactRulePreviewReply.$comment: sample: up to 10 matching artifacts (id, name, size).

ArtifactRulePreviewRequest.$comment: Operator only. rule: a retention rule of the project settings.

ArtifactView.$comment: One artifact with its copies; availability available (with a presigned url), unavailable, or the artifact state.

Block.$comment: One thread entry (docs/designs/fleet-conversations.md), told apart by kind. key is its position seq:part. Fleet's own projection: closed.

BoundaryBlock.$comment: Start of an execution in the thread.

Budget.$comment: scope person, project, experiment or connection; action warn, pause or stop; period day, week, month or null (all time). spend only in budgets_list.

BudgetAskRequest.$comment: Asks the owner to raise a budget above its current limit.

BudgetSetRequest.$comment: Owner only. No id: a new budget. action defaults to warn.

BudgetSpend.$comment: basis measured (value is the spend in the budget's unit and period) or unverifiable (value null).

CatalogueDefinition.$comment: The whole config/catalogue.json as it is today (one capability).

CatalogueReply.$comment: The definition editors change methods to CatalogueMethodView items (docs/designs/fleet-definition-editors.md).

Change.$comment: One committed change (the change table), as GET /api/stream and changes_since deliver it.

ChangeKind.$comment: The kinds the change triggers write (fleet_change and fleet_artifact_change in go/coordinator/schema.sql); a go test checks the triggers against this list.

ChangesSinceReply.$comment: resync: the cursor fell out of retention, reload everything. held: a writer still holds older changes; read again.

ChangesSinceRequest.$comment: No cursor: the head, with no changes. limit is clamped to 1..1000 (default 500).

ConnectionAccess.$comment: Who besides the holder may use the API key: people (emails), projects and experiments.

items.$comment: A key row: fingerprint, state (active, draining, disabled, retired) and times; never the value.
A setting change of this connection.

ConnectionView.$comment: An API connection; keys, spend and history only in connections_list.

ConnectionsCreateRequest.$comment: holder: the owner may create a key for another person.

ConnectionsKeyAddReply.$comment: The new key row (fingerprint, state, addedAt, addedBy); never the value.

ConnectionsKeyAddRequest.$comment: Owner only. The value goes to the secret file; the reply has its fingerprint only.

ConnectionsKeyStateReply.$comment: The key row after the change.

providers.$comment: The provider catalogue by provider id.

ConnectionsSetAccessRequest.$comment: access: {people, projects, experiments}, each a list of ids.

ConnectionsTokenCreateReply.$comment: token: the bearer value, shown once; refused: requested connections the owner cannot use.

ConnectionsTokenCreateRequest.$comment: The owner only (not an agent). The token value is answered once.

DefinitionConflict.$comment: Body of a 409 from definition_save and definition_create.

DefinitionContent.$comment: Exactly one property, matching the kind.

DefinitionExportRequest.$comment: No keys: every definition in state ahead or store-only. repository-changed and repository-deleted are never exported (named keys in those states: 409 repository-changed) until a save resolves them, so an export cannot revert a release.

DefinitionMirrorResetRequest.$comment: confirm must be the repository name; owner only. Rebuilds the mirror branch from store history and force-pushes.

DefinitionRef.$comment: With draft true, revision is the base revision (0 for a new definition) and contentSha is the draft's.

DiffFile.$comment: state added, removed, unchanged or modified; textChange only for small html and css files.

DiffSide.$comment: Exactly one of revision, draft (the caller's draft) or repository (the shipped file).

DirectSearchReply.$comment: A pipeline run with its steps, state and results (pipelineRun).

DirectSearchRequest.$comment: Runs the project's method for a capability (pipeline_run) or a direct search; idempotent by requestId.

DispatchOrder.$comment: list: the section 6 order list; soonest_reset: ready candidates by earliest weekly reset among those with weekly left above 0 (fleet-people-access.md section 8)

EffectiveLayer.$comment: source is a path or a URL; revision is the store revision, the specq commit or the project file sha; fields lists the setting paths this layer decides.

ExecutionDifferencesRequest.$comment: previous: the earlier execution of the same session.

items.$comment: A stored host event (native data stays raw).

ExecutionRow.$comment: One execution row (executionCols in go/coordinator/tasks.go); times are RFC 3339.

resume.$comment: session_resume's reply for the execution's session.

ExecutionStatusReply.$comment: next: the suggested operation (message, session_fork, execution_status or wait_or_steer). stop only after a stop request.

ExecutionStopReply.$comment: The stop command and the stop outcome.

ExecutionsListRequest.$comment: Filters; problem true keeps executions with a problem.

FieldChange.$comment: fromText and toText are the canonical JSON text of the old and new values; the editor uses path to place the attention tick.

FocusSetRequest.$comment: projectIds: a list of project ids in the caller's grants, or "*".

HostRecord.$comment: A registered host (without its secret hash). harnesses: per harness name whether it is allowed; autoUpdate on, off or an RFC 3339 time.

HostRow.$comment: One host as the Hosts screen shows it: configured, observed, or both; problems only while it polls.

HostWriteReply.$comment: secret: only when Fleet minted it (no secretSha256 given); shown once.

HostsRegisterRequest.$comment: Owner only. secretSha256: the sha256 of a secret the host already holds; absent: Fleet mints one.

HostsUpdateRequest.$comment: Owner, or the holder for their own host.

LabExperimentPromoteRequest.$comment: Replaces lab_promote's request when lab_experiment_promote is built.

ListFilter.$comment: The list filter of packages/view-url toPageParams; a null projectId is work outside projects.

ListMembershipRequest.$comment: At most 1000 ids and one or two lists.

ListRow.$comment: A task or session row of a list page; sortKey positions it (strings and numbers).

MeReply.$comment: email, name and grantsVersion are null without a person (agent-only stand).

MembershipAnswer.$comment: rows: the ids that are members of the list now.

MessageSendReply.$comment: The execution the message started, or the queued message with queued: true and its position.

MirrorState.$comment: Stage 2 only; the mirror and definition_mirror_reset fields and operation are added with it.

OpError.$comment: Body of every failed operation (writeError in go/coordinator/main.go).

items.$comment: One people.json entry (email, name, roles, owner, grants); never the service token's client ID.

PeopleSetReply.$comment: people: how many people the list now has.

PeopleSetRequest.$comment: Owner only: the whole people.json list, written atomically and reloaded.

email.$comment: default: the caller; another person: the owner only
default: the caller; another person: the owner only

PipelineGetReply.$comment: A pipeline run with its steps, state and results (pipelineRun).

items.$comment: A pipeline run with its steps, state and results (pipelineRun).

PipelineRunCreateRequest.$comment: Body of POST /api/pipelines/{id}/runs (pipelineRunCreate) as an operation pipeline_run_create; pipelineId was the URL segment. draft true runs the caller's draft. The request signature includes draft and the content sha.

PipelineRunReply.$comment: A pipeline run with its steps, state and results (pipelineRun).

PipelineRunRequest.$comment: Runs the project's method for a capability (pipeline_run) or a direct search; idempotent by requestId.

PipelineStep.$comment: Step kinds are the registry's (D20); validatePipeline stays the full check.

Problem.$comment: Validation finding; path is a JSON pointer into the content. A draft is stored even when invalid; save refuses it.

ProjectContextReply.$comment: The project's context (projectContext): settings, roles, connections, rules.

items.$comment: A project's context (projectContext): settings, roles, connections, rules.

ProjectQuestion.$comment: A project question to the operator; state waiting or answered.

items.$comment: A host's readiness for the project.

QuestionAnswerReply.$comment: A project question (ProjectQuestion), or the answered question row for any other question.

QuestionAnswerRequest.$comment: Answers a project question, or any other question by id.

QuestionBlock.$comment: options: the stored options as they are (a list of labels for agent questions).

QuestionRow.$comment: One question row (questionCols in go/coordinator/tasks.go); artifactIds and cause only when set.

items.$comment: A queued message with queued: true and its position (1 is next).

ReconcileReply.$comment: What reconcile settled: queue and handoff state, and the executions it could not prove.

ReplyReply.$comment: The answered agent question record with its delivery.

ResultBlock.$comment: The stored artifacts of an ended execution.

SessionArchiveReply.$comment: {sessionId, archivedAt, teardown: null} when no execution is left to tear down, else the teardown command it queued (id, executionId, hostId, kind teardown, payload, status).

SessionCreateReply.$comment: The new session row, plus sessionId.

SessionGetReply.$comment: The session view: the session row with its executions, questions, focus and handoffs.

SessionProfileReply.$comment: transition, handoffId and nativeSessionId only when the session has a native session to move.

SessionResumeReply.$comment: How the session continues: its harness, account and native session ids.

SessionStartReply.$comment: existing: the requestId already started this session.

SessionsListReply.$comment: nextAfter: null on the last page, else the sort key to pass as after.

SessionsListRequest.$comment: after: the nextAfter of the previous page.

items.$comment: A setting-change record: target, field, previous, value, actor, at.

SettingChangesRequest.$comment: target: one setting target (host:<id>, connection:<name>, people, ...); before: the nextBefore of the previous page.

StopOutcome.$comment: outcome proven (detail stopped or already_finished) or unknown (detail unconfirmed, with the stop command when one exists).

StoreSetFreeSpaceWarningRequest.$comment: Operator only. bytes: a whole number; null clears the warning.

StoresListReply.$comment: problems: full stores and placement problems the caller may see, each with its actions.

StreamCursor.$comment: Body of the GET /api/stream events ready (the cursor the stream starts after) and resync (reload everything, then continue after cursor).

SubscriptionLimit.$comment: The subscription fields as stored on the managed-account record.

SubscriptionLimitsRefreshRequest.$comment: fleet-people-access.md section 8 "Read without a run": one subscription, or every one the caller holds (the owner: all)

TaskCreateRequest.$comment: held: the task waits for task_release (always for an agent).

TaskDetail.$comment: A task with its progress, totals, executions, dependencies and questions (taskGet).

TaskProgress.$comment: executions: the count; byState: counts by execution state.

TaskRequestAcceptanceRequest.$comment: No artifactIds: the task's stored originals.

TaskUpdateRequest.$comment: action pause, resume, cancel or fail (people only); the other fields replace the stored value when present.

TextBlock.$comment: role agent or operator; by: the sender of an operator message; stream open or cut-off while a delta is the newest text; harness, model and effort mark agent text.

ThreadBlocksReply.$comment: removed: block keys that no longer exist.

ThreadBlocksRequest.$comment: rows: changed records; the reply has their current blocks.

ThreadEntriesReply.$comment: total: only with around. feedCursor: the change cursor of this read, to catch up from.

ThreadKey.$comment: Exactly one of task or session.

ToolBlock.$comment: input and output are the harness's own values; times in ms.

TransportAuthorizeRequest.$comment: Exactly these four keys (the request signature is their hash).

TransportInspectReply.$comment: Retained transport of one execution; never reruns native work.

VariantVsBaseline.$comment: Added to lab_experiment_get: one per non-baseline variant, over examples where both have a final score.

ViewLinkReply.$comment: For view: url and path; for url: the parsed view.

ViewLinkRequest.$comment: Exactly one of view (a view state to link) or url (a Fleet URL to read back).

WatchRecord.$comment: A session's watch: kinds of foreign changes that wake it, an optional timer, and its wake count.

WorkerDoneReply.$comment: action accepted (with the report) or rejected (with code: invalid_outcome, stale_dispatch, already_reported, native_identity_conflict, and reason).

WorkerDoneRequest.$comment: outcome succeeded or failed; anything else is recorded as rejected (invalid_outcome). summary: a string; any other value is stored as null.
